WIC17A-01.note: The layer is ground off and binned unanalyzed (sentence 2) to protect the result: a sacrificial step. 'diagnostic' tempts (lab context, richest lipid layer) but fails because the powder is never analyzed; 'redundant' fails because the step has a purpose.

WIC17A-02.note: She suspects the effect works only in combination with the new anesthetic protocol, so it is contingent. 'spurious' tempts on her caution but is killed by 'not a fluke'; 'marginal' is killed by 'a large effect'.

WIC17A-03.note: Parts swapped by two workers in an afternoon vs. five-month closure decides repairable. 'durable' is the main lure but the timber deck was replaced three times and strength was never tested; 'affordable' is killed by 'cost more'.

WIC17A-04.note: The bees never touch anthers and their flowers set no more seed than bagged ones, so they are pollinators in name only (nominal). 'occasional' fails because they outnumber all others 4:1; 'exclusive' fails because bumblebees did the pollinating.

WIC17A-05.note: 'it simply reports nothing' gives silent. Each distractor is explicitly killed by a planted detail: fickle by 'behaves the same way on every scan', sluggish by 'within seconds', invasive by 'without removing a single flake'.

WIC17A-06.note: Two halves dropped ~4,000 years apart, separated by a buried soil, make the arc composite. 'fragmentary' tempts but the arc is 'single unbroken'; 'displaced' is killed by the final sentence; 'uniform' is the overturned old view.

WIC17B-01.note: Reports covered only cases judges chose to circulate, and the unpublished dockets differ, so the figure is partial (it covers a selected subset). 'inexact' is the strong lure, but the count of reported decisions is complete and accurate; it is unrepresentative, not imprecise. 'trivial' is killed by 'still worth knowing'; 'derivative' by 'the first such count'.

WIC17B-02.note: Fieldworkers never name the object and show only a drawing to avoid leading the speaker, so the elicitation is indirect. 'voluntary' is the closest lure (the speaker's word is unprompted), but it would describe the step as optional; 'hurried' is killed by the minute-long wait and 'public' by 'sat alone'.

WIC17B-03.note: Prices were flat, smuggling was open, and no merchant petitioned, so the duty existed only on paper: nominal. 'temporary' is killed by 'kept until 1831', 'disputed' by 'never once petitioned', and 'ruinous' is the Velmar contrast.

WIC17B-04.note: Consistent placement and players saying a 'plain' tune is no longer the tune make the ornaments integral. 'optional' is the overturned transcribers' view, 'individual' is killed by 'every fiddler... same beats', and 'borrowed' by 'no neighboring repertory'.

WIC17B-05.note: The same castle was reused from one pricked drawing behind three saints and is absent from contracts, so the landscapes are generic. 'symbolic' is killed by 'does not bear on any of the three saints' legends', 'unfinished' by 'fully painted', and 'specified' by contracts that never mention the setting.

WIC17B-06.note: Equal payments and one equal payout each per cycle make the arrangement reciprocal. 'charitable' is the overturned view flagged by 'suggest otherwise', 'compulsory' is killed by 'could leave', and 'secretive' by 'read aloud at every meeting'.
